name: testflow
//engines: 22 because firebase-admin@14 requires >=22 — that is the whole reason, and it is NOT what fixed the ERR_REQUIRE_ESM crash in the auth routes. That looked like a Node floor problem and wasn't: prod was already on 22.23 and still threw, because Vercel's runtime has require(esm) disabled rather than missing. See overrides.jose for the actual fix, and do not treat raising this number as a substitute for it. Written as a bare major, not a range: Vercel only ships whole majors (24.x/22.x/20.x) and this is the form its docs specify. .nvmrc carries the same number for hosts that read that instead. GET /api/health reports the Node version the deployment actually got, plus whether firebase-admin/auth loaded.
//overrides.jose: Pinned BACK to 5.x on purpose — do not let this drift up to 6. jwks-rsa (via firebase-admin/auth) does a top-level require('jose'), and jose@6 is ESM-only, so that require can only work through Node's require(esm). Vercel's runtime reports Node 22.23 yet still throws the pre-require(esm) ERR_REQUIRE_ESM, so the feature is off there and the Node version is NOT the lever it looks like. jose@5 exposes a real CJS build via its `require` export condition, which makes the whole question moot on any runtime. jwks-rsa only ever calls importJWK, exportSPKI, decodeJwt and decodeProtectedHeader, all unchanged between 5 and 6, and it already branches on importJWK returning a KeyObject (5) rather than a CryptoKey (6). Nothing else in the tree depends on jose.
